recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-25205 unless OO opens a new issue for broader date-capture guidance beyond this published resolution.
issue_request: FHIR-25205 was Published as Not Persuasive with Modification for STU3/R5. It asked where to represent distinct creation/scanning/reference dates after DocumentReference.created was removed, and the accepted resolution narrowed the change to clarifying that repeated DocumentReference.content attachments are not different versions; versions should be separate DocumentReference resources linked by DocumentReference.relatesTo.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly names FHIR-25205. The application appears in the August 2020 DocumentReference block-vote commit 0bf0b46 after the OO 2020-07-16 block vote, where the historical spreadsheet source gained the DocumentReference.content comment forbidding different versions in repeated content and directing version handling to multiple DocumentReference resources with .relatesTo. Commit 33b409a migrated the wording into the current StructureDefinition XML, and commit 465bcbf preserved it while adding separate FHIR-17909 title guidance.
additional_context: The referenced Zulip thread confirms the original ambiguity came from the R4 removal of DocumentReference.created and interpretation of Attachment.creation. FHIR-17453 is the earlier published decision that removed DocumentReference.created as redundant with Attachment.creation. Later DocumentReference relatesTo/related cleanup in commit 3800384 added implementation-note language that relatesTo is for lifecycle changes such as revisions and transforms. DocumentReference is active in source/fhir.ini and assigned to OO.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current source/documentreference/structuredefinition-DocumentReference.xml definition/comment/requirements already state the requested content repetition/version rule, and source/documentreference/documentreference-notes.xml now supplies the implementation-note lifecycle guidance for relatesTo. Additional date-specific prose would go beyond the accepted resolution.
